banner: REAL_DOCUMENT_UNLABELLED — real public documents, no human event labels; harness-level measurements only, no accuracy claim

matching_protocol.unit: events, micro-averaged over documents that have a prediction record
matching_protocol.matching: greedy 1:1 within each document: gold events in dataset order, predicted events in output order, first compatible unused pair wins
match_requires: dates compatible: exact equality when gold.event_date is present; date-agnostic when gold.event_date is null
matching_protocol.field_protocol: entity/date/published-at/citation metrics use a second greedy pairing that requires only event_category, so a wrong entity or date is reported as such instead of collapsing into fp+fn
matching_protocol.date_rule: exact string equality on YYYY / YYYY-MM / YYYY-MM-DD when the gold date is present; a null gold date is date-agnostic
matching_protocol.citation_rule: correct when at least one predicted evidence quote is a verbatim substring of the document (whitespace/case-normalised fallback) and overlaps the gold evidence quote (containment, or longest common substring >= max(24, half the gold quote length))
matching_protocol.abstention_rule: a document abstains when it asserts zero extracted events (no events, all abstained, or a parse failure); wrong_abstention is an abstention on a document that has gold events
matching_protocol.negative_control_rule: a case with expected_abstain=True and no gold events; asserting any event on it is a false assertion
matching_protocol.duplicate_rule: identical asserted events within one document are counted in the error taxonomy
matching_protocol.support: documents that have a prediction record
